_metadata.description: Statistical distributions for cold-chain excursion modelling
sources: Kartoglu et al. 2010, WHO Cold Chain Guidelines

excursion_temperature.notes: Above-range (warm) excursions only; freeze events handled separately

excursion_duration.notes: Duration of a single excursion event

freeze_duration.notes: Duration of a single freeze event

inter_excursion_interval.notes: Time between successive warm excursion events (days)

season_correction.notes: Seasonal correction factors applied to excursion_temperature mean
